description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B: Where do two lexical dimensions stop being accepted, each varied alone: the number of ANDs in a WHERE chain of distinct conditions id <> -k (50, 98, 99, 100, 101, 200, 1000), and the parenthesis nesting depth around one predicate id > 0 (16, 32, 50, 63, 64, 65, 100, 128, 256)? Each text is opened directly; phase and errors are captured. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
